blocks.prompt:
1 What is analytical chemistry? Explain qualitative and quantitative analysis and list the major steps of a complete quantitative determination. (4 marks)
(Analytical chemistry kya hai? Qualitative aur quantitative analysis samjhayein aur mukammal quantitative determination ke bare steps likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Analytical chemistry: chemical characterization (kimiyai pehchaan) ki science. Kisi compound ki mukammal pehchaan mein qualitative aur quantitative dono analyses shaamil hon.

Qualitative analysis: compound mein maujood elements ki pehchaan (detection).
Quantitative analysis: compound mein elements ki nisbati miqdaar maloom karna.

Mukammal quantitative determination ke chaar bare steps:
1. Analysis ke liye sample lena.
2. Matloob juz (constituent) ko alag karna.
3. Measurement aur nataij ka hisaab.
4. Analysis se nateeja nikaalna.

Is liye alehdgi (separation) bunyadi step hai; chapter ke tareeqe (filtration, crystallization, distillation, chromatography) isi kaam aate hain.

book_ref.quote: A complete chemical characterization of a compound must include both qualitative and quantitative analyses.

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the separation of a mixture of common salt and sand by filtration. Explain the terms solution, solute, solvent, filtrate and residue. (4 marks)
(Namak aur rait ke mixture ki filtration se alehdgi bayan karein. Solution, solute, solvent, filtrate aur residue ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Filtration do ajza wale heterogeneous (ghair-yaksaan) mixture ka aik juz alag karti hai. Pehle aisa solvent chunte hain jis mein aik juz poora hal ho aur doosra taqreeban hal na ho.

Tareeqa:
1. Namak-rait mixture distilled paani mein daalein. Namak poore paani mein phail kar homogeneous mixture, yani namak ka solution banata hai.
2. Rait hal nahi hoti aur kuch der baad neeche baith jati hai.
3. Mixture ko funnel mein filter paper par daalein (Figure 15.1). Namak wala paani guzar jata hai; rait ruk jati hai.

Istilahaat:
Solution: namak aur paani ka homogeneous mixture.
Solute: namak, jo hal hota hai.
Solvent: paani, jo solute se zyada miqdaar mein hai.
Filtrate: funnel ke neeche conical flask mein aane wala liquid.
Residue: funnel par bachi rait.

Filtration filter paper ya filter crucible se ho sakti hai; precipitate ki nauiyat filter medium tay karti hai.

book_ref.quote: This process is used to separate one of the components of a two-component heterogeneous mixture

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe filtration through a filter paper. How is the rate of filtration increased by a fluted filter paper? (4 marks)
(Filter paper se filtration bayan karein. Fluted filter paper se filtration ki raftaar kaise barhti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Filter paper se filtration:
1. Glass funnel aur filter paper se filtration aam tor par sust amal hai. Mixture daalne par solvent (paani) guzar jata hai aur latke hue zarraat paper par reh jate hain.
2. Filter paper mukhtalif porosity (pore size) mein milte hain; pore size precipitate ke zarraat ke size par munhasir hai.
3. Paper itna bara ho ke filtration ke aakhir mein chauthai se aadha precipitate se bhara ho.
4. Tah kiya paper (Figure 15.2a) 60-degree funnel mein rakh kar paani se geela kiya aur mazbooti se dabaya jata hai.

Fluted filter paper:
Fluted filter paper se conical funnel mein filtration ki raftaar kaafi barh jati hai. Aam paper ko is tarah tah karte hain ke pankhe jaisi shakal bane jis ki tahon par baari baari ubhaar aur gehraiyan hon (Figure 15.2b).

Filtration ke baad neeche flask ka liquid filtrate aur paper par bacha solid residue hai.

book_ref.quote: Filter papers are available in a variety of porosities (pore sizes).

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe filtration by suction through a crucible. Give the construction and uses of the Gooch crucible and the sintered glass crucible. (4 marks)
(Crucible se suction ke zariye filtration bayan karein. Gooch crucible aur sintered glass crucible ki banawat aur istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Precipitate filter karne ka aik aur aasaan tareeqa crucible se suction (khinchaao) hai. Do qisam aam hain.

1. Gooch crucible (Figure 15.3):
• Porcelain ka, surakhon wala pinda, jo paper pulp ya naap ke filter paper se dhaanpa jata hai.
• Suction filtering apparatus mein rakhne se tez filtration.
• Un precipitates ke liye mufeed jinhein zyada temperature par ignite (jalaana) karna ho.
• Surakh asbestos mat se dhaanpein to paper se react karne wale solutions, maslan concentrated HCl aur KMnO₄, filter ho sakte hain.
• Crystallization mein vacuum pump ke saath crystals ko mother liquor se alag karne mein bhi istemal hota hai.

2. Sintered glass crucible (Figure 15.4):
• Glass crucible jis ke pinde mein porous glass disc seal hoti hai.
• Istemal mein bohat aasaan, kyun ke Gooch crucible ki tarah tayyari nahi karni parti.

book_ref.quote: Two types of crucibles are generally used.

blocks.prompt:
5 State the basic principle of crystallization. Describe the steps of crystallization up to the formation of crystals. (4 marks)
(Crystallization ka bunyadi usool bayan karein. Crystals banne tak crystallization ke steps bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: solute zyada temperature par munasib solvent mein hal ho, aur thanda karne par zaid solute crystals ki shakal mein bahar aa jaye.

Steps (Figure 15.5):
1. Saturated solution: experiment ke temperature par munasib solvent mein substance ka saturated (sair-shuda) solution banayein. (Munasib solvent boiling point par zyada aur room temperature par kam hal kare, solute se react na kare, aur thanda hone par achhe crystals de.)
2. Garm filtration: garm saturated solution filter kar ke ghair-hal-pazeer impurities nikaalein. Is se solute filter paper ya funnel ki nali mein waqt se pehle crystallize nahi hota; zaroorat ho to hot water funnel.
3. Thanda karna: garm filter shuda solution darmiyani raftaar se thanda karein taake darmiyane size ke crystals banein.

Rang door karna (zaroorat par): substance ko solvent mein bareek pise animal charcoal ke saath ubaal kar garm filter karte hain; charcoal rangdaar impurities adsorb karta hai aur thanda hone par saaf substance crystallize hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The process of crystallization involves the following steps.

blocks.prompt:
6 How are crystals separated from the mother liquor and dried after crystallization? Describe drying in an oven and in a vacuum desiccator. (4 marks)
(Crystallization ke baad crystals mother liquor se kaise alag aur khushk kiye jate hain? Oven aur vacuum desiccator mein sukhaana bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Crystals alag karna:
Crystallization mukammal hone par crystals aur mother liquor ka mixture vacuum pump ke saath Gooch crucible se filter kiya jata hai.

Crystals sukhaana:
1. Hawa mein: crystals hawa mein sukhaaye ja sakte hain.
2. Oven: oven mein tabhi jab substance 100 °C par na pighle aur na decompose ho.
3. Vacuum desiccator: mehfooz aur qabil-e-aitbaar tareeqa. Crystals watch glass par phaila kar kayi ghante vacuum desiccator mein rakhe jate hain. Drying agents: CaCl₂, silica gel ya phosphorus pentaoxide.

Sookhe crystals saaf product hain; phir un ki purity, maslan melting point se, check ki ja sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: When the crystallization is complete, the mixture of crystals and the mother liquor is filtered

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the simple distillation of sea water to obtain drinkable water. Name the distillate and the residue. (4 marks)
(Peene ka paani hasil karne ke liye samandari paani ki simple distillation bayan karein. Distillate aur residue ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Simple distillation solid ke solution se solvent alag karti hai. Samandari paani mein bohat se hal shuda inorganic compounds hain, is liye peene ke qabil nahi; distillation unhein door karti hai.

Tareeqa:
1. Distillation flask mein 100 cm³ samandari paani lein aur apparatus lagayein.
2. Bumping (jhatke se uchhalna) rokne ke liye boiling chips ke chand tukre daalein.
3. Vapours ko bahar nikalne se rokne ke liye poora apparatus air tight karein.
4. Bunsen burner se flask ahista garm karein aur tap khol dein taake condenser ke gird thanda paani ahista ghoome.
5. Boiling point par paani bukhaarat banta hai; vapours condenser se guzarte hain jahan thanda paani unhein dobara liquid bana deta hai.

Distillate: receiving flask mein jama condensed paani (peene ka paani).
Residue: distillation flask mein bache ajza (hal shuda inorganic compounds).

book_ref.quote: Heat the flask gently with the help of a Bunsen burner.

blocks.prompt:
8 What is fractional distillation? Describe the separation of a mixture of ethyl alcohol and water by fractional distillation and give its use in the petroleum industry. (4 marks)
(Fractional distillation kya hai? Ethyl alcohol aur paani ke mixture ki fractional distillation se alehdgi bayan karein aur petroleum mein is ka istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Fractional distillation: distillation ki woh qisam jo boiling points ki bunyaad par do aise liquids alag karti hai jo aapas mein hal ya miscible hon.

Distillation column: flask par lagi glass ki equipment jis mein glass beads bhare hote hain taake vapour ke condense hone ke liye satah ka raqba barhe (Figure 15.7). Thanda paani condenser mein neeche se daakhil aur upar se kharij hota hai.

Ethyl alcohol-paani mixture (Figure 15.6):
1. Mixture ko distillation flask mein garm karein. Ethyl alcohol (b.p. 78 °C) pehle distil hota hai kyun ke us ka boiling point paani (100 °C) se kam hai.
2. Jab tak alcohol distil ho, thermometer 78 °C par rehta hai.
3. Temperature 78 °C se upar jaane lage to receiving flask badal dein.
4. Dobara garm karein. 100 °C par paani ubalta hai aur condense ho kar doosre distillate ki shakal mein jama hota hai.

Petroleum: qudrati petroleum fuels (petrol, diesel, kerosene, furnace oil) ka mixture hai jin ke boiling points qareeb qareeb hain. Yeh fractionating column ke zariye fractional distillation se fractions mein alag kiye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Separating the two miscible liquids in this way is called fractional distillation.

blocks.prompt:
9 Define chromatography. Explain the stationary and mobile phases, and describe adsorption and partition chromatography with examples. (4 marks)
(Chromatography ki definition likhein. Stationary aur mobile phases samjhayein, aur adsorption aur partition chromatography misalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Chromatography: mixture ke sample ko alag karne ka tareeqa. Is mein solute (mixture) stationary phase aur mobile phase ke darmiyan taqseem hota hai.

Stationary phase: solid, ya inert solid ki satah par patli tah ki shakal mein liquid.
Mobile phase: stationary phase ki satah par behta hai; gas ya liquid ho sakta hai.

Qismein:

book_ref.quote: Chromatography is a method used primarily for the separation of a sample of mixture.

rows: Substance mobile phase chhor kar solid ki satah par adsorb ho jata hai.
Alag hone wale substances stationary aur mobile dono phases mein phaile hote hain.
Misalein: paper chromatography, gas liquid chromatography.

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the procedure of ascending paper chromatography for separating the components of a mixture. (4 marks)
(Mixture ke ajza alag karne ke liye ascending paper chromatography ka tareeqa bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Paper chromatography partition chromatography ki qisam hai: paper ke cellulose fibres mein phansa paani stationary phase, aur us se na milne wala mobile phase (aksar organic liquid). Yeh ascending, descending ya radial / circular hoti hai; ascending mein solvent capillary action se upar charhta hai.

Tareeqa (Figure 15.8):
1. Sample ke mutabiq banaya solvent mixture chromatographic tank mein daalein aur andar ki fiza yaksaan karne ke liye tank dhaanp dein.
2. Whatman paper No. 1 ki taqreeban 20 cm patti lein aur aik sire se 2.5 cm par patli pencil line lagayein.
3. Line par sample solution ka spot lagayein; pehchaan ke liye saath maloom compounds ke spots bhi.
4. Spots sookh jayein to paper clips se latkayein ke spot wala sira 5-6 mm solvent mein doobe. Tank dhaanp dein.
5. Solvent front spots se guzarta hai to solutes mukhtalif raftaar se upar chalte hain aur mixture alag ho jata hai.
6. Solvent front kaafi upar charh jaye to patti nikaalein, pencil se solvent front ka nishaan lagayein aur sukhaayein. Bana naqsh chromatogram hai.

book_ref.quote: Only the ascending type will be discussed here.

blocks.prompt:
11 How are colourless spots on a chromatogram located? Define the Rf value and explain how it is used to identify substances and to check purity. (4 marks)
(Chromatogram par berang spots kaise dhoonde jate hain? Rf value ki definition likhein aur batayein ke is se substances ki pehchaan aur purity kaise check hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Berang spots dhoondna: sookhne par paper ka naqsh chromatogram hai. Rangdaar ajza seedhe nazar aate hain. Berang hon to chromatogram chemical ya physical tareeqon se develop karte hain:
• UV lamp: UV light mein spots rangdaar nazar aate hain.
• Locating agent: aisa chemical (maslan ninhydrin) jo berang substances (jaise amino acids) se react kar ke dikhne wale rangdaar products banaye.

Rf value (retardation factor): har component ki khaas Rf value hoti hai.
Rf = asal spot se component ka faasla ÷ asal spot se solvent ka faasla
Figure 15.10 mein Rf(B) = x/y aur Rf(C) = x'/y, saare faasle base line se.

Istemal:
1. Purity: khaalis substance aik spot deta hai; na-khaalis aik se zyada.
2. Pehchaan: sample ko maloom khaalis substances ke saath chalaate hain. Jin do substances ki Rf values barabar hon woh aik hi ho sakte hain; aik hi stationary aur mobile phase mein substance ki Rf hamesha aik jaisi rehti hai. Figure 15.10 mein sample A ke do spots khaalis B aur C jitna faasla chalte hain, is liye A mein B aur C dono hain.

book_ref.quote: Paper chromatography is a convenient way of checking if a substance formed in a chemical reaction is pure or impure

blocks.prompt:
12 An unknown sample is run on paper chromatography alongside two pure reference compounds X (Rf = 0.30) and Y (Rf = 0.70), using the same paper and solvent. The solvent front travels 9.0 cm from the base line, and the sample gives two spots at 2.7 cm and 6.3 cm from the base line. Calculate the Rf values of the two spots, identify the components and state whether the sample is pure. (4 marks)
(Aik na-maloom sample ko do khaalis reference compounds X (Rf = 0.30) aur Y (Rf = 0.70) ke saath aik hi paper aur solvent par chalaaya gaya. Solvent front base line se 9.0 cm chala, aur sample ke do spots base line se 2.7 cm aur 6.3 cm par aaye. Dono spots ki Rf values nikalein, ajza pehchaanein aur batayein ke sample khaalis hai ya nahi.)
blocks.explanation: Har spot ki Rf nikaalein (spot ka faasla ÷ solvent ka faasla, dono base line se) aur khaalis references ki Rf se milaayein.

book_ref.quote: the chromatogram shows that the sample A contains both components B and C

steps: Rf = component ka faasla ÷ solvent ka faasla (dono asal spot se); y = 9.0 cm.
Aik hi stationary aur mobile phase mein barabar Rf ka matlab aik hi substance: spot 1 = X (0.30), spot 2 = Y (0.70).
Sample aik se zyada spot deta hai, is liye khaalis nahi; is mein X aur Y dono hain.
blocks.final_answer: Rf values 0.30 aur 0.70; sample mein X aur Y hain, yeh na-khaalis (mixture) hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 A mixture of two dyes P and Q is separated on paper. Under the conditions used, Rf(P) = 0.25 and Rf(Q) = 0.55. The run is stopped when the solvent front is 14.0 cm above the base line. Calculate how far each spot has moved from the base line and the distance between the two spots. (4 marks)
(Do dyes P aur Q ka mixture paper par alag kiya gaya. In conditions mein Rf(P) = 0.25 aur Rf(Q) = 0.55 hai. Run tab roka gaya jab solvent front base line se 14.0 cm upar tha. Har spot base line se kitna chala aur dono spots ke darmiyan faasla kitna hai, nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Rf = x/y ko x = Rf × y likh kar har dye ka faasla nikaalein, phir dono faaslon ka farq lein.

book_ref.quote: Each component has a specific retardation factor

steps: Rf = x/y, is liye x = Rf × y, jahan y = 14.0 cm (base line se solvent).
Spots ka darmiyani faasla = 7.7 cm − 3.5 cm = 4.2 cm
Q ki Rf zyada hai, is liye us ka spot upar hai; dono dyes mukhtalif raftaar se chal kar alag hote hain.
blocks.final_answer: P base line se 3.5 cm aur Q 7.7 cm chala; spots ke darmiyan 4.2 cm faasla hai.

blocks.prompt:
14 How is the purity of a liquid checked? Describe the preparation of aspirin and the three ways of checking the purity of the product. (4 marks)
(Liquid ki purity kaise check hoti hai? Aspirin ki tayyari aur product ki purity check karne ke teen tareeqe bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Liquids aam tor par normal pressure ya vacuum mein distil kar ke saaf kiye jate hain. Purity un ke boiling points ko literature ki qeemat se mila kar check hoti hai.

Aspirin ki tayyari:
Aspirin, aham analgesic (dard-kush) aur antipyretic (bukhaar-kush), salicylic acid ko zaid acetic anhydride se concentrated H₂SO₄ ki chand boondon ki maujoodgi mein react kar ke banti hai:
salicylic acid + acetic anhydride → (conc. H₂SO₄) → acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin)
Reaction ke baad paani daal kar aspirin precipitate karte hain; filter kar ke crude aspirin milti hai, jo paani (polar solvent) mein crystallize ki jati hai.

Purity check (product mein bacha hua salicylic acid ho sakta hai):
1. Melting point: theek 136 °C par sharply pighle to khaalis; aik range mein pighle to na-khaalis.
2. Mixed melting point: product ko khaalis aspirin se mila kar melting point naapein; phir bhi sharp ho to khaalis.
3. Paper chromatography: sample ko khaalis aspirin aur khaalis salicylic acid ke saath chala kar Rf values milaayein; khaalis product aspirin se milta aik spot deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Separate methods are applied to purify compounds if they exist in liquid or solid states under normal conditions.
